description_en: Renews a subscription ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 手动续费包年包月的MongoDB实例
name: RenewDBInstance

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without calling the operation. The system checks the request parameters, request format, service limits, and available resources. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false (default): sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次请求执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查，不真正调用该接口。检查项包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行本次操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The renewal duration of the instance. Unit: months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36
parameters.help_zh: 实例续费时长，单位为月。取值：1~9，12，24，36
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:
true: enables automatic payment. Make sure that your account has sufficient balance.
<props="china">- false: disables automatic payment. You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console, choose Billing > Expenses and Costs in the upper-right corner, choose Orders > My Orders in the left-side navigation pane, and then find the target order on the Orders tab to complete the payment.</props>
<props="intl">- false: disables automatic payment. You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console, choose Billing > Expenses and Costs in the upper-right corner, click Order Management in the left-side navigation pane, and then find the target order on the Orders page to complete the payment.</props>

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费。取值：
true：自动付费，请确保账号有足够的余额。
<props="china">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，选择订购订单>我的订单，在商品订单页签找到目标订单进行支付。</props>
<props="intl">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，单击订单管理，在商品订单页面找到目标订单进行支付。</props>

默认值为：true
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:
default or null (default): uses a coupon.
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank: does not use a coupon
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券，取值说明：
default或null（默认）：使用优惠券。
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:
true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费，取值说明：
true：开启自动续费。
false：不开启自动续费。

默认值为 false
parameters.name: auto_renew

OrderId.description_en: The ID of the generated order
